title: Reading Drill — Repairing the Trail Map
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Repairing the Trail Map
passages.body:
**A** A forest trail map printed years ago showed paths that had been absorbed into nearby farms. A team surveyed the current routes and compared its notes with the boundary register.

**B** Revising the map meant removing several attractive but unofficial shortcuts. To avoid surprising regular walkers, the team put temporary signposts at the places where the new route diverged.

**C** The reprint left space for a grid and a short web address. This allowed walkers to report a blocked path by giving a precise location even when they did not know its name.
